Game Overview

Dudes vs. Zombies puts players into a adventure experience centered on stand against relentless waves of the undead as one of the brave "Dudes" wielding makeshift weapons. Survive the chaotic onslaught with strategic moves and upgrading power. Test your endurance and skills, unlocking new heroes as the horde swells. Only the cleverest will endure this high-risk, fast-paced action challenge.
